notes: Q313 is the only serial project in NSTS. Its SIS found up to $29M of 69 kV rebuilds. By the Facilities Study, APS had rebuilt the Willow Lake line itself and the Dugas–Poland–Dewey rebuild was gone, leaving the $6.8M POI switchyard and a $0.1M switch fix.
In-service NSTS projects (Q113, Q196, SP107) have no open network upgrades in the posted reports.
view_note: Q313 (95 MW PV + BESS) is the only serial project in NSTS. Its 2020 SIS showed up to $29M of 69 kV rebuilds. The 2021 Facilities Study dropped them, leaving a $6.8M new switchyard and a $0.1M switch fix.
full_note: NSTS carries almost nothing forward from the serial queue: Q313's 69 kV rebuilds fell away before its Facilities Study, so the cluster rows hold all of the area's shared upgrades.
